scope: Reconstruction of original monthly event-study question on original24 sampled2022 dates; legacy/observed diagnostics separate; no causal validation
monthly_model: Asset FE, sampled-date FE, BTC-by-calendar-month interactions; June reference; January–May5-restriction pretrend reference
event_month_clock: January=-6,...,June=-1,July=0,...,December=5; two original sampled dates per month
saturated_warning: Date-level interactions perfectly fit the sole treated observation per date. Date-cluster event covariance is degenerate and cannot supply a valid F/t reference.
